import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from engine import project
def ref_contrib(m, b, c, u, v):
    cl = lambda x: max(0, min(x, c-b))
    return (m*cl(v-b))//(c-b) - (m*cl(u-b))//(c-b)
rng = random.Random(4242)
ok = 0
for trial in range(20000):
    U = rng.randint(2, 80)
    b = rng.randint(0, U-1); c = rng.randint(b+1, U)
    u = rng.randint(0, U-1); v = rng.randint(u+1, U)
    m = rng.randint(0, 10**12)
    if b > 0:
        old, vals = [0, b, c, U], [0, m, 0]
    else:
        old, vals = [0, c, U], [m, 0]
    new = [0, u, v, U] if u > 0 else [0, v, U]
    out = project(old, vals, new, len(new)-1)
    got = out[1] if u > 0 else out[0]
    assert got == ref_contrib(m, b, c, u, v), (m, b, c, u, v, got, ref_contrib(m,b,c,u,v))
    ok += 1
print('projection matches the literal protocol formula on %d random cases' % ok)

# also verify with a 3-range old partition vs many new ranges, brute force
for trial in range(3000):
    U = rng.randint(3, 50)
    old = [0] + sorted(rng.sample(range(1, U), rng.randint(0, 3))) + [U]
    new = [0] + sorted(rng.sample(range(1, U), rng.randint(0, 4))) + [U]
    vals = [rng.randint(0, 500) for _ in range(len(old)-1)]
    out = project(old, vals, new, len(new)-1)
    exp = [0]*(len(new)-1)
    for j, m in enumerate(vals):
        b, c = old[j], old[j+1]
        for k in range(len(new)-1):
            exp[k] += ref_contrib(m, b, c, new[k], new[k+1])
    assert out == exp, (old, vals, new, out, exp)
    assert sum(out) == sum(vals)
print('multi-range projection matches brute force')
EOF
